name: salesforce-pilot
title: Salesforce Pilot
description: Open, authenticate, and manage Salesforce orgs from your SF CLI keystore.
author: stiven_gonzalez

commands.name: orgs-list
commands.title: Salesforce Orgs
commands.subtitle: Salesforce Pilot
commands.description: List authenticated orgs, open them in the browser, manage defaults/aliases, and remove orgs.

commands.name: export-settings
commands.title: Export Settings
commands.subtitle: Salesforce Pilot
commands.description: Export org display prefs and pins to a JSON file in Downloads.

commands.name: import-settings
commands.title: Import Settings
commands.subtitle: Salesforce Pilot
commands.description: Import org display prefs and pins from a Salesforce Pilot JSON export.

preferences.name: projectsRoot
preferences.title: Projects Scan Folder
preferences.description: Folder to scan for Salesforce DX projects and editor workspaces.

preferences.name: editorCommand
preferences.title: Editor Command
preferences.description: CLI command used to open projects (must be on PATH).

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
